title: cyperus gracillimus
intro: Cyperus gracillimus, commonly known as the Slender Sedge, is a type of sedge plant native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Cyperus gracillimus are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions.
